lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: In the last three fiscal years, retail sales of prepared food and dispensed beverage and grocery and general merchandise items have generated about 36% of our total revenue, but they have resulted in approximately 63% of our revenue less cost of goods sold (excluding depreciation and amortization).

Sales of tobacco and nicotine products, including e-cigarettes and vapor products, have averaged approximately 9% of our total revenue over the past three fiscal years, and our tobacco and nicotine revenue less cost of goods sold (excluding depreciation and amortization) accounted for approximately 9% of the total revenue less cost of goods sold (excluding depreciation and amortization) for the same period.
Certain stores outside of that radius, in Florida for example, are supplied by a third-party distribution partner.
In addition, we rely on our vendors and suppliers to provide safe, quality ingredients and products and to comply with applicable food, food-safety, and other laws and industry standards.

We rely on our distribution and transportation network, which includes our drivers and distribution center Team Members, and the networks of our vendors and direct store delivery partners, to provide products to our distribution centers and stores in a timely and cost-effective manner.
We also depend on regular deliveries of products from third-parties to and from our facilities and stores that meet our specifications.
In addition, we may have a single supplier or limited number of suppliers for certain products.
We also rely on our ability to recruit, hire and retain qualified drivers, distribution center Team Members, field management and store Team Members.

Our continued success depends on our ability to remain relevant with respect to consumer needs and wants, attitudes toward our industry, and our guests’ preferences for new and innovative items and for ways of doing business with us, particularly with respect to digital engagement, third-party delivery, curbside pick-up and other non-traditional ordering and delivery platforms.

We rely on our information technology systems, and a number of third-party software and technology providers, to support numerous aspects of our business, and a disruption of these systems could adversely affect our business.

Over the past three fiscal years, on average our retail fuel revenues accounted for approximately 62% of total revenue and our retail fuel revenue less cost of goods sold (excluding depreciation and amortization) accounted for approximately 34% of the total revenue less cost of goods sold (excluding depreciation and amortization).
Depreciation and amortization expense increased $46,311 (11.5%) to $449,958 in fiscal 2026, primarily due to purchases of property and equipment since the prior period.
We strongly encourage investors to review our financial statements and publicly filed reports in their entirety and not to rely on any single financial measure.
Due to the nature of our business, cash provided by operations is our primary source of liquidity.
Our primary source of operating cash flows is from sales to guests at our stores.
